edgeProfile.irreversibleLosses: dimensions no later step can recover

composition.principle: bottleneck-min per dimension, renormalized over touched dimensions only

sourceAware.effect: edges with contentRequirements.requiresTextLayer are rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_PATH for scanned PDFs

familyRules.document: text/structure/layout/tables/images dominate; TXT targets zero out layout/images
familyRules.image: mediaQuality/resolution/alpha; JPG targets destroy alpha irreversibly
familyRules.audio: mediaQuality + reencode generations; lossless targets add no codec loss
familyRules.data: structure; tabular targets flatten types irreversibly

unknownPolicy: UNKNOWN edges get conservative defaults with factor 0.92 and never displace BENCHMARKED routes (certification is tiebreaker #3)
fallbackPolicy: designed, not activated: ranked alternatives are available to the executor; silent fallback is forbidden; fallbackUsed must be recorded if ever enabled
engineRealityFindings: ffmpeg adapter only stream-copies for →mkv targets; →mp4 is always transcode-video (annotations aligned)
binary detection guard added to probeTextStructure so media containers stop misdetecting as text/plain
monetization: none — quality score is never a price; product policy layer explicitly out of scope
